title: AI Video Subtitle Studio - Voiceover & Subtitle Platform
shortDescription: Automated system for speech recognition (Whisper), multilingual translation, and AI voice dubbing (TTS) directly in the browser, supporting subtitle editing and accurate audio synchronization.

overview.summary: AI Video Subtitle Studio is a smart video editing tool that automates the process of extracting subtitles, translating languages, and generating artificial voice (Voice Dubbing) for each video segment quickly and accurately.
overview.background: Traditional subtitling and voice dubbing takes a lot of time from transcribing, time alignment to recording. This solution helps content creators minimize the time for multilingual processing, especially for short content (Shorts, Reels).

challenge.title: Challenge of Accuracy & Multilingual Synchronization
challenge.problem: Handling accurate speech recognition with diverse videos, maintaining context during translation, and especially seamlessly syncing the new AI voice (TTS) timing with the original video without lagging the interface.
bottlenecks: The Speech-to-Text process requires high accuracy and precise time separation (timestamps) down to the millisecond.
Processing Text-to-Speech and integrating it into the video requires complex state management on the frontend.
Running AI models directly can consume resources if not properly configured and optimized.

solution.title: Optimized Architecture with FastAPI Backend & Local AI Models
solution.approach: Using FastAPI as a backend to handle powerful AI tasks combined with a task queue (Huey worker), communicating with the React frontend via API. Allows flexibility to choose between local models (Local Whisper) or cloud services (OpenAI, ElevenLabs).
keyInnovations: Integrating the locally-run faster-whisper model with multiple configuration options (Tiny, Base, Small) to optimize user hardware.
Intuitive Segment Management interface, allowing error correction, voice generation, and immediate preview.
Secure API Key setup system and flexible configuration for LLM translation and advanced voice generation services.

architecture.overview: Client-Server architecture with a smooth React/Vite Frontend UI and a powerful Python FastAPI Backend serving AI Inference.

layers.detail: Intuitive video player, real-time synchronized subtitle segment list, translation and dubbing state management.
Handles requests from the Frontend, manages the queue of heavy tasks (like speech recognition, audio generation) to avoid blocking the server.

layers.tech: faster-whisper, ElevenLabs API, OpenAI API, Kokoro (Local TTS)
layers.detail: Performs audio transcription (STT), contextual translation, and studio-quality speech synthesis (TTS).
Processes audio splitting, merging, mixing, and exports the final video file after dubbing.

features.title: Smart Subtitle Segment Management
features.description: The segment list interface allows users to view and edit timestamps, original content, translated content, and generate separate voices.
technicalHighlights: Real-time synchronization between the video player and the segment list.
Extracts and displays the voice generation (TTS) status of each subtitle line independently.

features.title: Flexible AI & API Configuration
features.description: Supports running multi-option local Whisper to save costs, while flexibly connecting APIs for translation and voice generation.
technicalHighlights: Supports fully offline faster-whisper (Tiny, Base, Small, Medium).
Integrates ElevenLabs and OpenAI with a secure API key storage mechanism.

features.title: Intuitive On-Video Editing Tools
features.description: Integrates a video player with customizable display features (color, font size, position) and convenient shortcuts for quick manipulation.
technicalHighlights: 'Subtitle Masking' feature to cover the original subtitles of the video.
Supports drag-and-drop subtitle positioning and quick video skipping via clicks.

gallery.title: Segment Management & Video Studio Interface
gallery.caption: The main interface allows video preview, subtitle display customization, and management of the segments to be dubbed.

gallery.title: AI System & Service Settings
gallery.caption: Flexible configuration of speech recognition models (Local Whisper) and APIs for translation and Text-to-Speech.

gallery.title: Interaction Guide & Shortcuts
gallery.caption: The system provides shortcuts and intuitive mouse interactions like fast-forwarding the video, positioning text, and generating voice quickly.

takeaways: Building an application that combines Local AI (cost-saving, secure) and Cloud APIs (high quality) brings the most optimal experience to users.
Complex state management in the Frontend is the key to creating a smooth and intuitive editing tool (Studio).
